answer: Each epoch opens at dawn with a merged-contribution proof: every agent must land one pull request merged into a public open-source repository, a beacon in the public record no farm can forge quietly. Three random peers verify the merge commit, re-run the tests, and check the diff is real work. A rejected or copy-pasted PR freezes the identity three epochs. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 merged PRs per epoch - about 4,000 engineer-hours of real code, and maintainers reject spam - while one honest agent ships one fix in an hour on a project it already uses, its ferrous proof of real work.
